ANV-AGG-01.title: Aggregate Stats are cumulative across venues
ANV-AGG-01.description: Checks that Aggregate Stats show cumulative figures that do not change when a different venue is selected in the header, as decided on 18 Nov 2026.
steps: Open Analytics > Aggregate Stats with venue 'Warehoust _NR' selected and read Submittals, Materials, Suppliers and Locations.
Choose another venue in the header site selector and read the same four figures again (the venue is switched back afterwards).
expected: The four figures are shown.
The four figures are the same as on 'Warehoust _NR'.
ANV-AGG-01.actual: As expected. The figures stayed the same after switching to another venue (for example Submittals 498, Suppliers 170, Locations 131).

ANV-INR-01.title: Inventory Reports follow the selected venue
ANV-INR-01.description: Checks that Inventory Reports load their figures for the venue selected in the header, since it is the only Analytics page meant to be location-based.
steps: Open Analytics > Inventory Reports and note the data the page loads.
expected: The page asks for its data for the selected venue.
ANV-INR-01.actual: As expected. The consumption figures are requested for the selected venue.

PL-REG-ALR-03.title: Edit an alert rule
PL-REG-ALR-03.description: Checks that an existing alert rule's value can be changed.
steps: Reload, search for the test submittal, choose 'Alert' then 'Add Alert' in the row menu; choose the first field, condition '>=', value 999, a message, and click 'Submit'; then click the rule's edit (pencil) button, change the value to 998 and submit.
expected: The message 'Alert created successfully!' appears and, after the edit, the row shows 998.

PL-REG-ALR-04.title: Delete an alert rule
PL-REG-ALR-04.description: Checks that an alert rule can be deleted from the submittal's alert list.
steps: Click the delete (bin) button on the test alert row and confirm if asked.
expected: The row disappears.

PL-REG-CMP-01.title: Add component requires date and quantity
PL-REG-CMP-01.description: Checks that a component cannot be added without a required-on-site date and a quantity, so incomplete components are not created.
steps: Open Procurement Log, search for a test submittal created by this run and click its Spec Description cell.
Click 'Add component', then click 'ADD' with all fields empty. Close the dialog afterwards.
expected: The submittal page opens and its address points to the submittal.
The messages 'Date Req. on Site is required' and 'Quantity is required' appear.

PL-REG-CMP-02.title: Component with a PO is Ordered with the supplier lead time
PL-REG-CMP-02.description: Checks that a component added with a purchase order is shown as 'Ordered' with the supplier's lead time, its PO number and its required-on-site (ROJ) date. The component row no longer shows an Expected Delivery date, so these values are checked instead.
steps: On the submittal page, click 'Add component'; enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10, Value 1000, a test PO number and PO Date today, and click 'ADD'.
Look at the new component row.
expected: A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.
Status is 'Ordered', lead time is '1 week', and the PO number and the ROJ date (today plus 28 days) are shown.

PL-REG-CMP-03.title: Component without a PO is Not ordered
PL-REG-CMP-03.description: Checks that a component added without a purchase order is shown as 'Not ordered', so users can see what still needs ordering.
steps: Open Procurement Log, search for a test submittal created by this run and click its description cell.
On the submittal page, click 'Add component', enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10 and Value 500, leave the PO empty and click 'ADD'.
Look at the status of the new component row.
expected: The submittal page opens with an 'Add component' button.
A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.
The status shows 'Not ordered'.

PL-REG-CMP-04.title: Add component defaults to the primary material
PL-REG-CMP-04.description: Checks that the Add component dialog offers the submittal's primary material and that a component can then be added with it.
steps: On the submittal page, click 'Add component' and look at the material options, then close the dialog.
Click 'Add component' again; choose the run's test material, enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10, Value 1000, a test PO number and PO Date today, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The dialog shows a material button marked '(primary)'.
A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-CMP-05.title: Currency defaults to the project currency
PL-REG-CMP-05.description: Checks that a new component uses the project's currency by default, so values are recorded in the right currency.
steps: Click 'Add component' and look at the currency selection, then close the dialog.
expected: 'Project default' with the project currency is selected.

PL-REG-CMP-06.title: Lead time update is saved and confirmed
PL-REG-CMP-06.description: Checks that updating a component's lead time saves the new number of weeks and marks it confirmed, so delivery forecasts stay current. The component row no longer shows an Expected Delivery date, so the lead time and 'Confirmed' are checked instead.
steps: In the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Lead time', enter 3, tick the confirm checkbox and click 'Submit'.
expected: The row shows lead time '3 weeks' and 'Confirmed'.

PL-REG-CMP-07.title: Record order (PO) changes the quantity
PL-REG-CMP-07.description: Checks that a component's quantity can be changed through 'Record order (PO)', so order quantities can be corrected.
steps: In the run's test component '⋯' menu choose 'Record order (PO)', set 'QTY' to 12 and click 'Update'.
expected: The component row shows 12.

PL-REG-CMP-08.title: Update component status to Delivered
PL-REG-CMP-08.description: Checks that setting a component's status to 'Delivered' is shown on the component and on the submittal, so delivery progress is visible.
steps: In the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Update status', choose status 'Delivered', enter a note and click 'ADD'.
expected: The component status becomes 'Delivered'.
PL-REG-CMP-08.actual: The component status did not change to 'Delivered'; it stayed 'Ordered' and no message was shown. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-046.

PL-REG-CMP-09.title: Update component status to Ordered At Risk
PL-REG-CMP-09.description: Checks that an ordered component can be flagged as 'Ordered At Risk', so users can highlight orders that may be late.
steps: In the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Update status', choose 'Ordered At Risk', enter a comment and click 'ADD'; then reopen the submittal and look at the component status.
expected: The component status is 'Ordered At Risk'.
PL-REG-CMP-09.actual: After reopening the submittal the component status was still 'Ordered'. The team is asked to confirm whether an ordered component may move to 'Ordered At Risk'. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-065.

PL-REG-CMP-10.title: Trigger alert sends a notification
PL-REG-CMP-10.description: Checks that a user can send an alert notification about a component, so the people involved are informed.
steps: In the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Trigger alert'; in the 'Send Notification' window click 'Send'.
expected: A message 'Notification sent successfully' appears.

PL-REG-CMP-11.title: Audit trail records the change
PL-REG-CMP-11.description: Checks that changes to a component are recorded in its audit trail with the user who made them, so changes can be traced.
steps: In the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Audit trail', then close the panel.
expected: Entries for 'actual quantity' and the signed-in user are listed.

PL-REG-CMP-15.title: Shift ROJ Apply stays disabled until Preview
PL-REG-CMP-15.description: Checks that required-on-site dates cannot be shifted before the user has previewed the change, which prevents unintended date changes.
steps: On the submittal page, click 'Select not-confirmed'.
Click 'Shift ROJ Dates' and enter Offset (days) 7 without clicking 'Preview'.
expected: The text '1 component selected' appears.
The 'Apply' button is disabled.

PL-REG-CMP-18.title: Delete a component
PL-REG-CMP-18.description: Checks that a component can be deleted from a submittal, so components added in error can be removed.
steps: Go back to the submittal; in the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Delete component…' and confirm 'Delete'.
expected: The component is removed and no component rows remain.
PL-REG-CMP-18.actual: No message was shown and the component row was still listed after Delete. The component had a confirmed lead time and was not ordered; the team is asked to confirm whether such a component may be deleted. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-072.

PL-REG-CMP-19.title: Component values use the project currency symbol
PL-REG-CMP-19.description: Checks that component values are shown with the project's currency symbol, so users are not misled about the currency.
steps: Reopen the submittal and click 'Show PO details' on the component row.
expected: 'Value' starts with ₹, as the project currency is INR.

PL-REG-DLV-01.title: Log a delivery for a component
PL-REG-DLV-01.description: Checks that a delivery can be logged against a component with the right material item, so received goods are recorded.
steps: Reopen the run's test submittal and choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu.
Click 'Log delivery', then 'Add Delivery'; open 'Choose Item Name', pick the material, enter today's date, the first location and quantity 4, and click 'Add'.
expected: The component view opens and its address points to the component.
'Choose Item Name' lists the material items; the dialog closes and the delivery shows 4.
PL-REG-DLV-01.actual: As expected. The item list showed the run's test material.

PL-REG-DLV-02.title: Delivering more than ordered is blocked
PL-REG-DLV-02.description: Checks that a delivery larger than the quantity still available cannot be logged, which keeps delivery records accurate.
steps: On the test submittal, choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu, then click 'Log delivery'; enter today's date, the first location, the material as item and QTY 20, and click 'Add'. Close the dialog afterwards.
expected: An error 'Quantity exceeds available quantity' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-03.title: Pre-shipping checklist needs every answer and comment
PL-REG-DLV-03.description: Checks that the pre-shipping checklist cannot be confirmed until every question is answered and every comment is filled in, so checklists are complete.
steps: Reload the component view, choose 'Delivery actions' > 'Pre-shipping info' and click 'Confirm Checklist' without answering anything.
Set every Y/N answer to 'YES' and click 'Confirm Checklist' without entering comments.
expected: A message 'Answer every Questions' appears.
A message 'Please complete all fields before submitting.' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-05.title: Confirm the pre-shipping checklist
PL-REG-DLV-05.description: Checks that a completed pre-shipping checklist can be confirmed and is then ready for approval.
steps: Click 'Confirm Checklist'.
expected: A message 'Shipping Details updated successfully!' appears and 'Delivery actions' offers 'Approve pre-shipping checklist'.

PL-REG-DLV-06.title: Approve the pre-shipping checklist
PL-REG-DLV-06.description: Checks that a confirmed pre-shipping checklist can be approved with a comment, so the delivery can move on.
steps: In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Approve pre-shipping checklist', enter an approval comment and click 'Approve'.
expected: A message 'Checklist Generated Successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-07.title: Reject and resubmit the pre-shipping checklist
PL-REG-DLV-07.description: Checks that a pre-shipping checklist can be rejected and then updated and confirmed again, so mistakes can be corrected.
steps: In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Approve pre-shipping checklist' and click 'Reject'.
In 'Delivery actions' choose the rejected checklist, open 'Update Pre-Shipping Details', fill in the checklist again and click 'Confirm Checklist'.
expected: 'Delivery actions' shows the checklist as rejected.
A message 'Shipping Details updated successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-08.title: Set the actual delivery date
PL-REG-DLV-08.description: Checks that the actual delivery date can be entered on a delivery with 'Receive', after which a goods received note can be generated.
steps: Reload the component view and click the delivery's 'Receive' button; in 'Edit Delivery' set the actual delivery date (second date box) to today and click 'Update'.
expected: The delivery moves to 'Received' with a receipt number, and 'Delivery actions' offers 'Generate GRN'.

PL-REG-DLV-09.title: Add shipping information to a delivery
PL-REG-DLV-09.description: Checks that shipping details can be added to a delivery, so the shipment can be tracked.
steps: In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Update shipping info'; in 'Add Shipping Info' choose mode 'Other', enter a test shipping reference, 'Origin' and a note, and click 'Add'.
expected: A message 'Shipping Details updated successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-10.title: Record delivery conditions with all goods in good order
PL-REG-DLV-10.description: Checks that the condition of delivered goods can be recorded, so damage and shortages are captured.
steps: In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Update delivery condition'; in 'Add Delivery Conditions' enter good quantity 4 and click 'Add'.
expected: A message 'Delivery Conditions updated successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-DLV-11.title: Delivering the remaining 6 marks the submittal Delivered
PL-REG-DLV-11.description: Checks that once the remaining quantity is delivered and its goods received note is generated, the Procurement Log list shows the status 'Delivered'.
steps: Open the test submittal, choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu and click 'Log delivery' with QTY 6; then complete the same steps as before: checklist, approval, 'Receive', shipping info, delivery conditions and 'Generate GRN'.
Go back to the submittal, then search for the test submittal in Procurement Log and read its 'Status'.
expected: The GRN is generated.
The 'Status' is 'Delivered'.

PL-REG-DLV-11b.title: Generate GRN for a partial delivery (4 of 12)
PL-REG-DLV-11b.description: Checks that a goods received note can be generated for a partial delivery of 4 out of 12, confirming receipt of the goods.
steps: In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Generate GRN'.
expected: A message 'GRN Generated Successfully!' appears (partial delivery, 4 of 12).

PL-REG-DLV-12.title: Delivered submittal shows its actual delivery date
PL-REG-DLV-12.description: Checks that a delivered submittal shows an actual delivery date in the Procurement Log list, so users can see when goods arrived.
steps: Open 'Procurement Log' from the menu and search for the test submittal created by this run.
expected: The submittal row has a value in 'Actual Delivery Date' (not empty or '-').

PL-REG-DLV-13.title: Partial delivery of 4 of 10 and shortage quantity
PL-REG-DLV-13.description: Checks that delivering 4 of 10 shows the submittal as 'Partial Delivery' and that the shortage is calculated from the delivered quantity, so delivery conditions are reported correctly.
steps: Choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu and click 'Log delivery' with QTY 4 (today, first location, item name). Through 'Delivery actions' fill in 'Pre-shipping info' and approve the checklist; click 'Receive' with today's actual date; then add shipping info, enter delivery conditions Good 3 and Damage 1, and choose 'Generate GRN'.
Go back to the submittal, then search for the test submittal in Procurement Log and read its 'Status'.
Check the Shortage QTY shown in Delivery Conditions.
expected: A message 'GRN Generated Successfully!' appears.
The 'Status' is 'Partial Delivery'.
Shortage QTY is 0, because all 4 delivered items are accounted for as good or damaged.
PL-REG-DLV-13.actual: The GRN was generated and the status became 'Partial Delivery', but Shortage QTY showed 6 instead of 0. It was calculated from the component quantity rather than the delivered quantity. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-044.

PL-REG-DLV-16.title: Component header shows the unit of measure
PL-REG-DLV-16.description: Checks that the required quantity in the component header is shown with its unit of measure, so users can read the quantity correctly.
steps: Reload the component view and read the required quantity line in the header (for example '12 Pieces required').
expected: The quantity is shown with its unit, with no 'undefined' text.

PL-REG-DLV-17.title: Download QR label as PNG and PDF
PL-REG-DLV-17.description: Checks that the submittal's QR label can be downloaded as a PNG sticker and a PDF sheet, so goods can be labelled.
steps: Click 'QR label', download 'PNG sticker' and 'PDF sheet', then close the QR window.
expected: Both files download with names in the form 'submittal-…-qr.png' and 'submittal-…-qr.pdf'.

PL-REG-DLV-18.title: 'All files' tab lists the component files
PL-REG-DLV-18.description: Checks that the 'All files' tab in the component view shows the files, so users can find documents attached to the component.
steps: In the component view, click the 'All files' tab.
expected: The list of received deliveries is replaced by the list of files.

PL-REG-DLV-19.title: Required Remaining Qty subtracts logged deliveries
PL-REG-DLV-19.description: Checks that the remaining quantity shown when logging a delivery takes earlier deliveries into account, so users know how much is still due.
steps: Click 'Log delivery', read 'Required Remaining Qty', then close the dialog.
expected: The value is 8 (12 ordered minus 4 already logged).
PL-REG-DLV-19.actual: Required Remaining Qty showed '12 Pieces' after 4 of 12 had been logged. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-060.

PL-REG-EDT-02.title: Edit Submittal may give a submittal the same Submittal No and material as another
PL-REG-EDT-02.description: Checks that editing a submittal saves the change even when it gives the submittal the same Submittal No and material as another submittal. The dev team confirmed on 24 Nov 2026 that this is allowed (Add Submittal still refuses such a pair).
steps: Search for a test submittal that shares its number with another one, choose 'Edit' in the row actions, replace its material with the other submittal's material, click 'Update', then close the dialog if it is still open.
expected: The change is saved and the message 'Submittal updated successfully' appears.
PL-REG-EDT-02.actual: As expected. The change was saved.

PL-REG-EDT-03.title: Assign a responsible user to a submittal
PL-REG-EDT-03.description: Checks that a responsible user can be assigned from a submittal's row actions.
steps: On a test submittal row choose 'Assign Responsible'; in the 'Responsible — <submittal>' dialog, under 'Add a Responsible person', pick the signed-in user, click 'Add' and then 'Done'.
expected: The user is listed as Responsible.

PL-REG-EDT-04.title: Assign a responsible user to two submittals at once
PL-REG-EDT-04.description: Checks that one responsible user can be assigned to several selected submittals in one action, using the bulk assign page.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal' and create a second test submittal (spec, description, Schedule Id, supplier 'LG', material '43 Inches').
Reload, search for this run's test submittals, tick both rows and click 'Bulk assign Responsible'.
In the people panel, filter by the signed-in user, tick that person, keep 'Add to existing Responsible', click 'Build list to review' and then 'Save'.
Search for this run's test submittals in Procurement Log.
expected: The message 'Submittal added successfully' appears.
The 'Bulk assign Responsible' page opens with 'Selected only (2)' submittals.
The review lists both test submittals with the user, and 'Save' applies any change (or both are already shown as 'Already Responsible').
The 'Responsible' column of both submittals names a person (not '-').

PL-REG-EDT-07.title: International Shipments shows the component's required date
PL-REG-EDT-07.description: Checks that a submittal flagged as international appears once in International Shipments with the component's required date.
steps: Open Procurement Log, search for the test submittal, choose 'Flag International' in the row menu, enter country 'South Korea' and click 'Flag' (done twice).
Open International Shipments from the left menu.
Check the submittal's row.
expected: The message 'Submittal flagged as international shipment.' appears each time.
Exactly one row is shown for the submittal.
The row contains the component's required date (today plus 28 days).

PL-REG-LST-06.title: Status filter shows only the chosen status
PL-REG-LST-06.description: Checks that the Status filter limits the list to the ticked status and can be removed again.
steps: Click the 'Status' filter, tick 'Delivered' and close the list.
Click the 'Status1' filter, untick 'Delivered' and close the list.
expected: Every row shows Status 'Delivered' and the button reads 'Status1'.
The filter is removed.

PL-REG-LST-17.title: A saved link opens the submittal
PL-REG-LST-17.description: Checks that a link to a submittal opens that submittal directly, so users can share or bookmark it.
steps: Click the test submittal's delivery chain to open its detail, and note the page address.
Open Procurement Log, then go to the noted address.
expected: The submittal page opens and its address points to the submittal.
The 'Add component' button is visible and the test submittal is shown.

PL-REG-LST-18.title: A saved link opens the component view
PL-REG-LST-18.description: Checks that a link to a component opens the component view directly.
steps: Go to the saved address of the test component.
expected: The 'Log delivery' button is visible.

PM-REG-CFG-09.title: Pre-Shipping setting turns the delivery checklist off and on
PM-REG-CFG-09.description: Checks that switching off 'Pre-Shipping Checklist' in Configuration Options removes the checklist from a delivery and switching it on brings it back.
steps: On a test submittal created by this run (material '43 Inches'), choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu and log a delivery of quantity 1 with 'Log delivery'.
In Configuration Options set 'Pre-Shipping Checklist' to Off, click 'Save' and reopen the same delivery.
Set 'Pre-Shipping Checklist' back to On, click 'Save' and reopen the same delivery.
expected: The delivery's 'Delivery actions' menu offers 'Pre-shipping info'.
'Pre-shipping info' is no longer offered.
'Pre-shipping info' is offered again.

PM-REG-PSC-03.title: Enabled PreShipping questions appear on deliveries
PM-REG-PSC-03.description: Checks that every question enabled on the PreShipping Checklist page is asked in a delivery's pre-shipping checklist.
steps: Open Project Management > 'PreShipping Checklist' and note the questions with 'Enabled' ticked.
Reload the component view, choose 'Delivery actions' > 'Pre-shipping info', check the questions and close it without answering.
expected: The enabled questions are noted.
The checklist lists every enabled question.

T155-01.title: Subcontractor can fill the pre-shipping checklist
T155-01.description: Checks that the fix for ticket BUGS-155 lets a subcontractor open and fill the pre-shipping checklist of a delivery.
steps: As the subcontractor, open Procurement Log, search for a test submittal from an earlier end-to-end run, open it and choose 'Open component' in the component's '⋯' menu.
In 'Delivery actions' choose 'Pre-shipping info', look at the checklist, then close it without confirming.
For the record, open the delivery on this run's submittal G (supplier 'LG').
expected: The delivery's 'Delivery actions' menu offers 'Pre-shipping info'.
The checklist opens with its questions and an enabled 'Confirm Checklist' button.
Note whether 'Pre-shipping info' is offered there too.

T155-02.title: Subcontractor approves a supplier's checklist
T155-02.description: Checks that the fix for ticket BUGS-155 lets a subcontractor approve a pre-shipping checklist that the supplier has filled.
steps: Fill the pre-shipping checklist on this run's submittal F as the supplier (using the admin account).
As the subcontractor, open 'Delivery actions', choose 'Approve pre-shipping checklist', then click 'Approve'.
expected: The checklist is filled.
The message 'Checklist Generated Successfully!' appears.

T517-13.title: Bulk Edit supplier change asks once
T517-13.description: Checks that the fix for ticket BUGS-517 shows one notice for the whole batch when Bulk Edit changes the supplier of several submittals, and resets the affected lead times.
steps: Open test submittal B; in the component row's '⋯' menu choose 'Lead time', enter 2, tick the confirm box and click 'Submit'.
In the submittal list, tick submittals A and B (both on the same test supplier), choose 'Supplier Name', pick 'LG' and click 'Preview Changes'.
Click 'Confirm & Apply' once.
While the batch is in review, check submittals A and B.
expected: B's component lead time is 2 weeks and marked 'Confirmed'.

The preview says 2 records will be updated, none are skipped, and one notice explains that the lead times of all 1 component(s) on 1 submittal(s) will change and 'Lead Time Confirmed' will be set to False.
At most one confirmation appears for the whole batch, and a banner shows the bulk update under review.
A and B show 'LG'; B's lead time is LG's (1 week) and not confirmed.
T517-13.actual: As expected. No separate confirmation appeared.

T543-04.title: Edit shows the linked categories ticked
T543-04.description: Checks that the fix for ticket BUGS-543 shows a question set's linked categories as selected when the set is edited.
steps: Select the question set created in T543-07 and click its edit (✎) button.
expected: The category linked to the set is ticked.

TC-10.title: Add components and confirm lead times
TC-10.description: Checks that a component can be added for each material, that the lead time from the supplier set-up can be confirmed, and that the expected delivery (PO date plus lead time) is not later than the required-on-site date. The component row no longer shows an Expected Delivery date, so the test checks the status, the lead time in weeks and 'Confirmed', and works out the expected delivery from the PO date.
steps: On the submittal page click 'Add component' for the primary material: required on site 22/12/2026, quantity 10, value 1000, a new PO number, PO date 24/11/2026.
Click 'Add component' for '43 Inches': required on site 29/12/2026, quantity 5, value 500, a second PO number, PO date 24/11/2026.
Check the components on the submittal.
For the primary material, check the lead time shown.
In the primary material's '⋯' menu choose 'Lead time', keep 1 week, tick the confirmation and click 'Submit'.
Compare the primary material's expected delivery with its required-on-site date.
For '43 Inches', check the lead time shown.
In the '43 Inches' '⋯' menu choose 'Lead time', keep 2 weeks, tick the confirmation and click 'Submit'.
Compare the '43 Inches' expected delivery with its required-on-site date.
expected: The message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears and the status is 'Ordered'.
The message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears and the status is 'Ordered'.
There are exactly 2 components, one per material.
Lead time is 1 week (from the supplier set-up), so the expected delivery is 01/12/2026 (PO date plus 1 week); this date is booked in the next case.
The lead time shows 'Confirmed' and is still 1 week.
Expected delivery 01/12/2026 is on or before the required date 22/12/2026, so the component is not 'At Risk'.
Lead time is 2 weeks (from the supplier set-up), so the expected delivery is 08/12/2026 (PO date plus 2 weeks); this date is booked in the next case.
The lead time shows 'Confirmed' and is still 2 weeks.
Expected delivery 08/12/2026 is on or before the required date 29/12/2026, so the component is not 'At Risk'.

TC-10B.title: Book a delivery for each component
TC-10B.description: Checks that one delivery booking can be logged for each component on its confirmed expected date.
steps: For the primary material choose 'Open component' in its '⋯' menu and click 'Log delivery': date 01/12/2026 (the confirmed expected date), the first location of site Warehoust _NR, the primary material, quantity 10, then click 'Add'.
Reopen the primary material's component.

For '43 Inches' choose 'Open component' in its '⋯' menu and click 'Log delivery': date 08/12/2026 (the confirmed expected date), the first location of site Warehoust _NR, '43 Inches', quantity 5, then click 'Add'.
Reopen the '43 Inches' component.
expected: The booking is created and 'Delivery actions' offers 'Pre-shipping info'.
Exactly one booking, dated 01/12/2026, on the test submittal; the submittal shows it as 'Next delivery'.
The booking is created and 'Delivery actions' offers 'Pre-shipping info'.
Exactly one booking, dated 08/12/2026, on the test submittal; the submittal shows it as 'Next delivery'.

TC-12.title: Assign a responsible user
TC-12.description: Checks that a responsible user can be assigned to a submittal and is shown in the list.
steps: On the test submittal row click '⋮', then 'Assign Responsible'; in the 'Responsible — <submittal>' dialog choose the Project Admin under 'Add a Responsible person', click 'Add' once, then 'Done'.
Look at the test submittal in Procurement Log.
expected: The Project Admin is listed as Responsible.
The 'Responsible' column shows the assigned user.

TC-14B.title: Supplier Inbox shows the delivery awaiting its checklist
TC-14B.description: Checks that the run delivery, booked but with its pre-shipping checklist not yet filled, appears in Enterprise > Supplier Inbox under Pending Pre-Shipping Checklists.
steps: Open Enterprise > Supplier Inbox and type the run submittal number in the Submittal filter.
Open the Pending Pre-Shipping Checklists section.
expected: The sections show counts for that submittal only.
The run submittal is listed with its deliveries.
TC-14B.actual: As expected. 1 submittal with 2 deliveries was pending a checklist.

TC-14C.description: Checks that a shipment can be logged for the run submittal in Enterprise Shipments and then appears in both shipment lists.
